scenes.tts: He came to Princeton as a young theorist to work near the man who had named the hydrophobic interaction, and tried to compute its energetic cost straight from myoglobin's coordinates. The coordinates were too crude. The project failed.
scenes.visual: Princeton, young theorist, man who named the hydrophobic interaction, compute energetic cost from myoglobin coordinates, too crude, project failed
scenes.narration: He came to Princeton as a young theorist to work near the man who had named the hydrophobic interaction, and tried to compute its energetic cost straight from myoglobin's coordinates. The coordinates were too crude. The project failed.

scenes.tts: So he changed what he thought the mathematics needed: if the numbers were the problem, someone had to make better numbers. He learned X-ray crystallography, traded pure theory for a craft that pins atoms down, and only then could he turn the force into a quantity.
scenes.visual: better numbers; pure theory traded for X-ray crystallography schematic; force becomes a quantity
scenes.narration: So he changed what he thought the mathematics needed: if the numbers were the problem, someone had to make better numbers. He learned X-ray crystallography, traded pure theory for a craft that pins atoms down, and only then could he turn the force into a quantity.

scenes.tts: "At last I was able to get down to energetic calculations on a protein, and came up with the idea of the hydrophobic moment," he said of the turn. "This and related ideas gave me for the first time the feeling that I could make discoveries."

scenes.tts: He spent the rest of his career watching hydrophobic burial go wrong: two beta-sheets locked so tightly they squeezed out every water molecule, side chains interlaced like a zipper's teeth.
scenes.visual: burial goes wrong; two beta-sheets squeeze out water; interlaced teeth
scenes.narration: He spent the rest of his career watching hydrophobic burial go wrong: two beta-sheets locked so tightly they squeezed out every water molecule, side chains interlaced like a zipper's teeth.

scenes.tts: He called it the steric zipper, and reduced a century of pathological clutter to one line: "We learned that the adhesive segments of the proteins that form these fibers are just short segments."
